kashika: त्रीणित्रीणीत्यनुवर्तते। त्रीणित्रीणि विभक्तिसंज्ञाश्च भवन्ति सुपस्तिङश्च। विभक्तिप्रदेशाः — <<अष्टन आ विभक्तौ>> [[७.२.८४]] इत्येवमादयः॥
kashikaEnglish: Triads of personal and case endings are called vibhakti (inflection).
englishShort: The सुप्-प्रत्ययाः and the तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः are called विभक्ति.
englishFull:
The triads of both तिङ् (verb endings) and सुप् (case endings) are called विभक्ति.

**Meaning:** विभक्ति = "division, inflection" — the endings that distinguish grammatical relations.

**Usage:** सप्तमी विभक्ति = the 7th triad (locative case endings: ङि, ओस्, सुप्).
